overview: Based on the published agenda, the Kronenwetter Parks Committee was scheduled to review previous meeting minutes, discuss village communications about parks, and consider the 2027-2036 Capital Improvements Program budget draft. The meeting was also set to address an upcoming Buska Park 5K fundraiser event and explore creation of a community support group for parks.

discussions.item: Village Communications About Our Parks Within the Community
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to discuss ongoing communications efforts regarding parks and recreation areas available to Kronenwetter residents.

discussions.item: Additional Ideas for Other Parkland and Related Village Property
discussions.body: The committee was set to consider potential expansion or development of additional parkland and related village-owned properties within the community.

discussions.item: 2027-2036 Capital Improvements Program (CIP) Budget – 1st Draft as of 07/31/2026
discussions.body: The committee was expected to review the first draft of the ten-year capital improvements budget as of July 31, 2026, which would address planned infrastructure and facility projects for parks.

discussions.item: September 12, 2026 Buska Park 5K Run/Walk Fundraiser Event
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to discuss planning and coordination for a fundraiser event set to take place at Buska Park in September 2026.

discussions.item: Creating a "Friends of the Kronenwetter Parks" Support Group
discussions.body: The committee was set to consider establishment of a community support organization dedicated to advocating for and supporting Kronenwetter's parks system.

discussions.item: Future Fundraising Ideas for Parks Fund
discussions.body: The committee was expected to explore and discuss additional fundraising opportunities and ideas to generate revenue for the parks fund.

publicComment: Public comment was indicated on the agenda, with a 15-minute total period and three-minute limit per person, subject to extension at the presiding officer's discretion.
